source_name: AIN.UA — фінтех/IT новини
why_relevant: Tech/startup trade press that covers the engineering and product side of Ukrainian fintech (Fintech Band / Fintech-IT Group, monobank, processing vendors) — CTO/CPO/HR-level moves and ownership/structure changes that banking outlets under-report.

source_name: НАБУ — Незалежна асоціація банків України, «Новини ринку»
why_relevant: Banking industry association republishing a curated market-news stream and announcing its own governance changes (e.g. ex-Oschadbank head Serhiy Naumov becoming association president). Acts as a pointer to member-bank press releases and to the outlets the industry itself considers authoritative.

source_name: Українська асоціація фінтех та інноваційних компаній (UAFIC) — Newsroom
why_relevant: Fintech association newsroom; organiser of Ukraine Fintech Week / Pay.Forum. Association leadership and event speaker rosters map the payments-side actor set, and member-company announcements surface hiring and structural moves at PSPs and processors.

source_name: jobs.dou.ua — профілі фінтех/банківських роботодавців
why_relevant: DOU company profiles and vacancy feeds are the standing Ukrainian labour-market record for tech-heavy fintech and bank IT employers; open vacancies and headcount trends are a leading indicator of restructuring and team build-out, complementing editorial appointment news. Surfaced here via the trade-press cell (PaySpace's own DOU page).

source_name: psm7.com/uk/career — сторінка вакансій PaySpace Magazine
why_relevant: Minor but concrete: shows the outlet's own hiring channel and confirms editorial staffing is CV-by-email rather than a public masthead — relevant when assessing how to source and contact PaySpace journalists covering personnel beats.

source_name: Finance.ua / uazmi.org — агрегатори українських фінансових новин
why_relevant: Aggregators that republish FinClub, Minfin, PaySpace and others under one index; useful as a safety net so a personnel item is not missed when one publisher's feed breaks, and as a way to discover smaller specialist outlets not yet on the source list. ukr.net also indexes Finbalance as a source channel.

source_name: ЄДР — безоплатний пошук (Мін'юст / usr.minjust.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Authoritative Unified State Register free-search interface: for any bank, payment institution or financial company it exposes the current signatory (керівник / підписант), legal form, EDRPOU code and registration actions. A director change is legally effective only once recorded here, so it is the earliest legally-binding evidence of a leadership move, typically ahead of any press release.

source_name: online.minjust.gov.ua — кабінет електронних сервісів Мін'юсту (пошук в ЄДР / замовлення витягу)
why_relevant: Second official entry point to the same register, used for ordering electronic витяг documents that state the appointed director and the date of the registration action — the document-grade proof behind a leadership-change signal.

source_name: data.gov.ua — набір даних «Єдиний державний реєстр юридичних осіб, ФОП та громадських формувань»
source_subtype: open-data bulk dump of statutory register
why_relevant: Bulk XML/ZIP dump of the whole USR published as open data. This is the only lawful way to enumerate every bank, payment institution and financial company in scope together with its recorded head, and to diff snapshots over time to detect director changes at scale — the backbone of an A5 leadership-change monitor.

source_name: ДП «НАІС» — реєстри та API реєстрів
why_relevant: NAIS is the state administrator of the USR and publishes the register inventory plus API documentation. It is the authoritative pointer that tells you which registers exist, what fields they expose (including officers/signatories) and the legitimate machine access route.

source_name: SMIDA — база розкриття інформації емітентів (НКЦПФР)
why_relevant: Issuers (including banks organised as joint-stock companies) are legally obliged to publish «Особлива інформація» on «Зміна складу посадових осіб емітента» — naming the person appointed or dismissed, the position, the date and often the biography. This is a mandatory, dated, structured leadership-change disclosure stream, and the single richest statutory source for A5 in Ukraine.

source_name: НКЦПФР — інформаційні бази та реєстри професійних учасників ринків капіталу
why_relevant: The securities regulator's register of licensed professional participants (traders, depositories, asset managers) enumerates the non-bank capital-market actors in scope and links to their disclosure cabinets, extending the entity watchlist beyond NBU-licensed institutions.

source_name: Державний реєстр банків — набір даних НБУ на data.gov.ua
source_subtype: regulator register published as open data
why_relevant: Machine-readable extract of the State Register of Banks: banks holding a licence, their separate subdivisions, banks in liquidation and accredited branches of foreign banks. Provides the canonical bank watchlist (with EDRPOU) that every director-change diff must be joined against, and licence-withdrawal events are themselves organization-change signals.

source_name: НБУ — Довідник банків та їх відокремлених підрозділів (API / файлові вивантаження)
why_relevant: Documented NBU data API for the banks-and-branches directory. Branch-network expansion or contraction is a direct organization-change and hiring proxy, and the directory supplies stable bank identifiers for joining register-derived director data.

source_name: Opendatabot — ЄДР пошук та моніторинг змін
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator over the state registers whose core product is precisely change monitoring: it pushes notifications when the ЄДР record of a watched company changes, including the director. It converts a snapshot register into an event stream, which is exactly what an A5 leadership-move monitor needs, and it also publishes ready-made bank and financial-institution lists.

source_name: Opendatabot — Банки України (перелік діючих банків)
why_relevant: Ready-made, EDRPOU-linked list of operating state and private banks that maps each bank straight into its ЄДР card, shortening the path from 'which entities are in scope' to 'who currently signs for them'.

source_name: Clarity Project — перевірка контрагентів та 140+ реєстрів
why_relevant: Free-tier register aggregator with per-EDRPOU company cards and a person-verification module listing every company where an individual holds or held an officer role. Useful as a low-cost first pass and cross-check on YouControl for banking and payment-company leadership graphs.

source_name: VKURSI.PRO — перевірка компаній та моніторинг 70+ реєстрів (з API)
why_relevant: Third independent register aggregator, notable because its API is publicly documented on GitHub and it explicitly sells change-monitoring across registers plus director/founder link analysis. A realistic, cheaper alternative or redundancy layer to Opendatabot for automated director-change detection.

source_name: OpenSanctions — Ukraine Consolidated State Registry (ext_ua_edr)
why_relevant: An English-language, entity-resolved rendering of the Ukrainian USR including directorship and ownership edges, downloadable in bulk. Valuable as an English-side pointer for name transliteration, entity matching across uk/en spellings, and for enriching bank officer names with PEP/sanctions context.

source_name: OpenCorporates — Ukraine jurisdiction company records
why_relevant: Indexes Ukrainian company filings in English with officer records; useful for cross-border name matching and for analysts without Ukrainian, but it lags the official register and must not be treated as compliance-grade or as a primary timing signal.

source_name: Єдиний державний реєстр декларацій (НАЗК) — public.nazk.gov.ua
why_relevant: Heads and board members of state-owned banks (Oschadbank, PrivatBank, Ukrgasbank, Sense Bank) and state enterprises fall under mandatory asset declaration. A first declaration filed by a new person, or a departure declaration, is a dated, statutory trace of a leadership move at exactly the institutions where press disclosure is slowest.

source_name: Фонд гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб — банки в управлінні Фонду
why_relevant: When a bank is declared insolvent the DGF appoints an «уповноважена особа Фонду» who legally displaces the bank's management. These appointment orders are a statutory, named, dated leadership-change and organization-change event, and each liquidated bank gets its own subdomain site carrying the appointment notices.

source_name: Гід онлайн-послуг «Дія» / my.gov.ua — процедура реєстрації змін відомостей про юрособу
why_relevant: Documents the legal mechanics and required documents (board decision appointing the director) and the timing of a registered director change. Essential methodological context for interpreting how quickly a real appointment shows up in the register and what evidentiary artefacts exist behind it.

source_name: NABU — Rada NABU (Council of the National/Independent Association of Banks of Ukraine)
why_relevant: Dedicated page listing the 11 elected Council members of Ukraine's main banking association, each identified by their current executive role at a named bank (e.g. Volodymyr Mudryi — Chairman of the Council and Chairman of the Management Board of OTP Bank; Olena Polianchuk — Deputy Chair, Deputy CEO/Head of Legal at UKRSIBBANK). Council seats are re-elected roughly every 4 years, so diffs on this page are a very low-noise signal of who currently holds senior bank positions and when they change.

source_name: NABU — Struktura / Komanda NABU (association structure and team)
why_relevant: Maps the association's governing bodies (General Assembly, Council, Revision Commission, Secretariat/Apparatus, 11 sectoral Committees) and the people staffing them. Gives the skeleton needed to interpret every subsequent election announcement, and the Secretariat listing is itself an employer-level org chart.

source_name: NABU — Apparatus / Secretariat page
why_relevant: Names the association's own executive staff (director general, department heads). Association staff are frequently ex-bank executives and are a recruitment pool in both directions; changes here are organization-change signals for the sector's lobbying layer.

source_name: NABU newsroom — General Assembly and committee-election announcements
why_relevant: The event-level, dated feed behind the governance pages: General Assembly reports announce newly elected Council members and priorities, and a separate release presents newly elected chairs of the 11 sectoral Committees (e.g. the Payment Technologies, Information Security and Anti-Payment-Fraud Committee, reported as headed by Dmytro Yanishevskyi). Each such release is a timestamped who-holds-what record naming the person's employer bank — exactly the A5 signal.
